# PaycheckCalc

> Free paycheck calculator for all 50 US states. Calculate take-home pay after federal, state, Social Security, and Medicare taxes with 2026 rates.

## About

PaycheckCalc is a free online tool that helps employees and job seekers estimate their take-home pay in any US state. All calculations run in the browser — no financial data is transmitted or stored. Operated by AI Peak Biz.

## Pages

- [Home](https://paycheck.center): State listing with links to all 50 state calculators
- [About](https://paycheck.center/about): Mission and methodology
- [Contact](https://paycheck.center/contact): FAQ and contact information

## State Calculators

Each state has a dedicated calculator page at `https://paycheck.center/{state-slug}` (e.g., `/california`, `/texas`, `/new-york`).

### What Each Calculator Covers
- Federal income tax (2026 brackets, 10%-37%, $15,000 standard deduction)
- State income tax (flat, progressive, or none depending on state)
- Social Security (6.2% on first $168,600)
- Medicare (1.45% on all earnings)
- Pay frequency options: annual, monthly, semi-monthly, bi-weekly, weekly

### No-Income-Tax States
Alaska, Florida, Nevada, New Hampshire, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Washington, Wyoming

## Limitations
- Single filer only (married filing jointly not yet supported)
- Does not account for pre-tax deductions (401k, health insurance)
- Does not include local/city taxes
- Estimates only — consult a tax professional for precise figures
